fjthp0dg.variantName: Walplus Faux Fur Christmas Tree Skirt - White - 90 cm
fjthp0dg.sourceDescription: This Christmas tree skirt helps hide your bare Christmas tree stand. So you can put ornaments and presents on it for decoration. This Christmas tree base featuring a non-woven fabric on the back and thick faux fur on the front is smooth and comfortable, adding a warm touch to your house. The tree skirt sits elegantly at the base of your Christmas tree, making it the perfect spot for placing and unboxing presents. This tree decoration also has long-lasting durability, so you can use it as a home carpet or store it for next year. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: 360 gsm faux fur Diameter: 90 cm Middle hole diameter: 10 cm With non-woven backing This christmas tree skirt is designed solely for domestic holiday decoration and floor protection. To prevent severe fire hazards or property damage, never allow the fabric to come into direct contact with open flames, hot candles, or exposed electrical wiring from holiday lights. Inspect all tree light strands for frayed cords before placing them near the skirt. Ensure the skirt is laid completely flat around the base of the tree stand to avoid creating a dangerous tripping hazard for residents or guests. Do not block access to water reservoirs on live trees. This seasonal textile product is not a toy; keep all decorative ties, metallic trim, small sequins, and plastic packaging completely out of the reach of infants, small children, and pets. Manufacturer Name: WALPLUS Address: Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingdom Contact: customer.service@walplus.com

nr5g6hhn.variantName: My Christmas 360° Degree Rotating Christmas Tree Stand with Remote Control
nr5g6hhn.sourceDescription: Showcase your Christmas tree from every angle with this rotating Christmas tree stand. Made from durable ABS material, it features a sturdy base designed to support trees weighing up to 35kg. The stand rotates smoothly through 360 degrees in either a clockwise or anticlockwise direction, completing 2.4 full rotations per minute. With three operating settings, you can choose to rotate the tree with its lights on, keep it stationary with the lights on, or switch off the lights while stationary. Supplied with a pole adapter to accommodate different centre pole diameters, it is suitable for compatible Christmas trees up to 8ft tall. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
